decision_scope: The target cannot be accepted as an independently closed evaluation subsystem. This is not a claim that every production component is unusable.
decision_reasons: A replacement fixture can copy case.expected, call no production Owner, and still receive a perfect Stateful score.
All 27 independently sealed fresh Stateful cases are unregistered coverage gaps, so no fresh executable closure exists.
Timeout and external cancellation do not have closed side-effect/audit semantics for write tools.
KnowledgeBase collapses chunk identity before ranking/projection, allowing returned content and reported chunk metadata to disagree.
There are zero human_reviewed cases, and 28 still-current non-Stateful cases retain unresolved Reviewer A revise/ambiguous judgments.

status_separation.implementation_status: Partial: named owners and runners exist, but fixture evidence provenance, cancellation terminality, timeout side-effect meaning, and multi-chunk RAG projection are not closed.
status_separation.mechanical_test_status: 137 repository tests passed; Stateful dev 80/80 and consumed heldout regression 20/20 passed.
status_separation.data_contract_reasonable: Partial: schema, checksum, group-safe split, corpus IDs, and review labels are structurally checked; expected truth and human review identity are not independently established.

context_assembler.budget_fact: ContextAssembler owns the preflight input-budget algebra; TokenEstimator is its provider-independent estimate, not an exact provider tokenizer.
mandatory_content: current user turn plus per-message protocol overhead
context_assembler.allocation: The remaining capacity is first divided between rendered sections and history. Sections are prioritized but restored to caller order; history retains the newest valid suffix. Unused history capacity can be returned once to sections using available minus retained-history cost.
context_assembler.rendering_boundary: Section description attributes, HTML/XML escaping, and the two-newline join separators are charged from the final rendered representation.
context_assembler.success_contract: estimated_tokens equals the recomputed TokenEstimator cost and is <= max_input_tokens.
context_assembler.unsupported_input_boundary: Only partially closed: mandatory overflow is typed, but malformed Python-level values can still raise generic TypeError/AttributeError/serialization errors.
context_assembler.independent_result: 20,000 fixed-seed generated inputs produced 15,581 successful prompts, 4,419 typed mandatory-overflow failures, zero successful-prompt budget violations, and zero wrong failure types.

memory_manager.archive_transition: Read Redis snapshot and summary, upsert stable message/chunk IDs via _archive_messages(reason=conversation_finalize), then WATCH/MULTI compare-and-clear. Concurrent change returns finalized=false, reason=concurrent_write.
memory_manager.summary_owner: MemoryManager._summarize; provider/parse failure delegates to _fallback_summary and then _bounded_summary.
memory_manager.empty_query_owner: MemoryManager.search_long_term returns before storage when its normalized query is empty.
memory_manager.identity_owner: api.main Principal.subject and _subject_for_request own authenticated request identity; MemoryManager applies the supplied user_id to both vector-query and lexical-corpus filters.
memory_manager.hybrid_recall_owner: HybridMemoryRetriever.rank owns vector/BM25/recency RRF over storage-filtered candidates.
memory_manager.failure_boundary: Storage failures are deliberately degraded to empty results rather than surfaced as typed retrieval failures.

stateful_runner.production_fact_owners: MemoryManager, ContextAssembler, MCPToolManager, ReActExecutionEngine, CoverageGate, AnswerVerifier, TicketService, or KnowledgeBase depending on the scenario
stateful_runner.evidence_owner: FixtureEvidence(assertions,details) as returned by the selected fixture
stateful_runner.scorer_owner: evaluation.benchmark compares actual assertion booleans with EvalCase.expected assertion booleans
stateful_runner.actual_chain: case -> complete EvalCase passed into fixture -> arbitrary FixtureEvidence booleans -> key-presence check -> scorer equality
stateful_runner.violated_invariant: Actual assertions must be derived from authoritative owner observations without expected truth being present on the result-producing path.

knowledge_base.source_document_id_owner: Versioned corpus id, persisted by KnowledgeBase.add_documents as metadata.document_id
knowledge_base.producer_result: evaluation.retrieval_runner loaded all 25 corpus documents into an isolated embedded Chroma collection and invoked production KnowledgeBase.search; replacing KnowledgeBase.search with an exception aborted the run.
knowledge_base.id_result: retrieved_ids are persisted metadata.document_id values, not titles, expected labels, or storage chunk hashes.
knowledge_base.violated_invariant: The selected content, selected chunk identity, and projected chunk metadata must describe the same retrieval candidate.
knowledge_base.counterexample: A query matching only the second chunk returned document_id persisted-document-777 and reported chunk=1, but content came from chunk 0 and omitted the matching evidence.

tools_trace_coverage_verifier.approval_owner: MCPToolManager._requires_approval and execute_for_agent's out-of-band host approved boolean
tools_trace_coverage_verifier.approval_boundary: approved is not exposed in the model tool schema, but it is not a signed approval_token.
tools_trace_coverage_verifier.side_effect_owner: The tool handler and its downstream business service; MCPToolManager has no transaction or compensation authority.
tools_trace_coverage_verifier.audit_owner: MCPToolManager._finish_controlled_call appends to a bounded in-process deque after call() returns.
tools_trace_coverage_verifier.trace_owner: In-process TraceRecorder plus contextvars, not durable OpenTelemetry storage.
tools_trace_coverage_verifier.coverage_owner: CoverageGate.evaluate owns duplicate, missing, unresolved-required, and unexpected task outcome classification.
tools_trace_coverage_verifier.verifier_owner: AnswerVerifier.verify owns PASS/REJECT/UNKNOWN; api.main.chat owns the public projection and handoff path.
positive_results: An unapproved write fixture blocks before invoking the handler.
CoverageGate fails closed for duplicate, missing, and unexpected outcomes.
A real verifier provider exception became UNKNOWN; the candidate was absent from both public response and saved memory, and a handoff was created.
External cancellation produced an error trace span.
open_results: A timed-out handler can spawn independent background work that commits after the ERROR result; zero side effect is not guaranteed.
External cancellation exits before _finish_controlled_call and leaves zero audit records.
There is no signed approval token, durable call ledger, business receipt, transaction, or compensation contract.

dataset_and_scorer.split_owner: Case author chooses split/group_id; DatasetBundle enforces supported split names and prevents one group crossing dev/heldout.
dataset_and_scorer.checksum_owner: Manifest cases_sha256 and optional corpus_sha256, verified by DatasetBundle.load.
dataset_and_scorer.corpus_reference_owner: DatasetBundle validates unique corpus IDs and retrieval expected IDs against that corpus.
dataset_and_scorer.review_status_owner: Case review metadata; human_reviewed requires nonempty reviewer, reviewed_at, and notes strings.
dataset_and_scorer.gold_boundary: The scorer may select human_reviewed cases, but it does not prove that review was independent or genuinely human.

required_questions.1_unique_owner: Owners are identifiable for prompt budget, memory lifecycle, authenticated identity, RAG candidate/projection, tool policy, coverage, verification, dataset structure, and scoring. Stateful assertion provenance and human Gold authority are not technically unique or enforceable.
required_questions.2_fixture_calls_owner: Selected existing fixtures do call their named Owners, and five required mutations fail. This is not universal proof: fixtures receive the complete EvalCase, hard-code much of the setup, and can return facts unrelated to the case's stated semantics.
required_questions.3_forged_boolean_detected: No. A no-owner fixture copied expected booleans and the heldout runner still scored 1.0.
required_questions.4_all_success_prompts_within_budget: Yes under ContextAssembler's own TokenEstimator and supported typed inputs in the 20,000-case probe. This is not a claim about exact provider tokenizer billing.
required_questions.5_unsupported_inputs_typed: Partially. Budget overflow and unknown fixtures are typed; tool/verifier domain outcomes are mostly typed. Malformed Python-level context inputs, broad memory storage degradation, unexpected injected verifier-object behavior, and external cancellation are not one closed typed algebra.
required_questions.6_rag_loads_corpus_and_calls_production_: Yes. The isolated producer inserted 25 corpus documents and called production KnowledgeBase.search. The owner mutation aborts the run.
required_questions.7_docs_exceed_proof: Yes in specific places: fixture anti-forgery, idle-time archive corpus text, universal tool-audit wording, and a stale retrieval-producer statement exceed or conflict with executable evidence. The main evaluation documentation correctly says there is no signed approval_token, real idle detector, complete cross-user retrieval, HTTP public projection proof, production accuracy, or human Gold.

counterexamples.symptom: A fixture with no production call copies expected booleans and receives a perfect score.
counterexamples.trigger: Replace the registered memory_context_budget fixture with a coroutine returning FixtureEvidence(assertions=case.expected.assertions).
counterexamples.immediate_mechanism: execute_case passes the complete EvalCase to the fixture and checks only that expected assertion keys exist; benchmark then trusts the returned values.
counterexamples.shared_root_cause: Expected truth and actual-result production share one trust domain; there is no enforceable owner-observation boundary.
counterexamples.violated_invariant: Expected data must not be available to actual producers, and every scored fact must be derived from an authoritative owner observation.
counterexamples.closure_effect: Blocks accept regardless of current 100/100 mechanical Stateful results.

counterexamples.symptom: The returned chunk number and content can describe different chunks.
counterexamples.trigger: Store a two-chunk document and query a fact present only in chunk 1.
counterexamples.immediate_mechanism: HybridMemoryRetriever deduplicates MemoryDocument by document_id, while KnowledgeBase metadata_by_id independently overwrites metadata for the same document_id.
counterexamples.shared_root_cause: Source document identity and retrieval candidate identity are collapsed before ranking and projection.
counterexamples.violated_invariant: Selected chunk content, chunk index, evidence ranks, and source document ID must remain aligned.

counterexamples.symptom: A write tool returns typed ERROR on timeout, then an independently scheduled background task commits a side effect.
counterexamples.trigger: Handler starts background work before awaiting beyond tool.timeout_s.
counterexamples.immediate_mechanism: asyncio.wait_for cancels the awaited handler task, not arbitrary child work that escaped its lifecycle.
counterexamples.shared_root_cause: The manager owns a call status but does not own transactional commit, idempotency, receipt, or compensation.
counterexamples.violated_invariant: A timeout result must not be interpreted as zero side effect unless the business owner proves that outcome.

counterexamples.symptom: Externally cancelling execute_for_agent leaves an error trace span but no audit record.
counterexamples.trigger: Cancel the host task after handler entry.
counterexamples.immediate_mechanism: CancelledError exits before the post-await _finish_controlled_call transition.
counterexamples.shared_root_cause: Terminal audit is appended after normal/error result conversion rather than owned by a finally-protected lifecycle transition.
counterexamples.violated_invariant: Every started controlled call must have one correlated terminal record, including cancellation and unknown side-effect outcome.

counterexamples.symptom: A visually blank query containing only U+200B and U+FEFF accesses both storage paths.
counterexamples.trigger: query consists only of zero-width space and BOM.
counterexamples.immediate_mechanism: Python str.strip does not remove these format characters.
counterexamples.shared_root_cause: The empty-query normalization contract is incidental Python behavior rather than an explicit bounded Unicode policy.
counterexamples.violated_invariant: Inputs classified as empty by the supported query contract must return without storage access.

current_primary_source_comparison.source: Anthropic, Demystifying evals for AI agents
current_primary_source_comparison.criterion: Separate task, trial, grader, transcript, outcome, and harness; verify actual environment end state; make graders resistant to bypass; calibrate against humans.
current_primary_source_comparison.assessment: DialogPilot separates files and components nominally, but FixtureEvidence can be fabricated from expected. The harness therefore does not enforce the outcome boundary. Deterministic scoring is positive; human calibration is absent.

current_primary_source_comparison.criterion: wait_for cancels the awaited object and waits for cancellation; it is a cancellation primitive, not a transaction or proof that external effects did not occur.
current_primary_source_comparison.assessment: The observed late background commit is consistent with this contract. DialogPilot must not infer zero side effect from TimeoutError.

current_primary_source_comparison.criterion: Write activities should be idempotent and retries/timeouts require explicit lifecycle design.
current_primary_source_comparison.assessment: This is a mature reference practice, not a recommendation to add Temporal. DialogPilot currently lacks an idempotency/receipt requirement for write handlers.

current_primary_source_comparison.criterion: Timeout and cancellation are explicit terminal events in a durable append-only audit history.
current_primary_source_comparison.assessment: DialogPilot's in-process post-return audit misses external cancellation. The relevant criterion is one durable/correlated terminal outcome, not adoption of event sourcing.

current_primary_source_comparison.criterion: Failed operations should mark span error status and error type consistently.
current_primary_source_comparison.assessment: The error span on cancellation is positive, but it does not replace the missing business/audit terminal record.

smallest_coherent_convergence_plan.change: Pass fixtures a stripped FixtureRequest containing scenario input and immutable case identity but no expected data. Return raw typed owner observations/receipts; derive assertion booleans after actual observations are sealed. Add a registry-wide anti-forgery/owner-mutation gate.

Preserve a unique chunk candidate identity through vector candidates, BM25, RRF, and projection. Aggregate to document_id only after selecting aligned chunk evidence, or return document_id plus the selected chunk identity.

Define terminal states for cancelled and outcome-unknown; append one correlated audit record in a cancellation-safe lifecycle. Require business idempotency keys and typed receipts for write effects. Do not label timeout/cancel as zero effect without a receipt.
Declare and implement a bounded Unicode blank-query normalization policy, including the selected format characters, then property-test no-storage behavior.
Human-adjudicate the 28 current Reviewer A disputes and preserve an independently attributable per-case review record before setting human_reviewed.

alternatives_and_tradeoffs: A narrow blacklist preventing .expected access in current fixtures is insufficient because the object still crosses the trust boundary.
A generalized event-sourcing framework is unnecessary; a typed terminal record and idempotent business receipt are sufficient for the bounded tool contract.
Document-level RAG aggregation is acceptable only if it retains and projects the selected chunk evidence consistently.
non_goals: No production-code change was made by Reviewer B.
No requirement to adopt Temporal, event sourcing, a new agent framework, or a signed-token system unless those become supported product scope.
No claim of exact vendor tokenization from TokenEstimator.
No claim of production accuracy from provisional dev or consumed regression results.
falsifiable_exit_criteria: A fixture that can access or copy expected cannot enter the actual-producing path; a deliberate no-owner forgery fails before scoring.
Every supported fresh action executes its declared production Owner and a registry-wide owner mutation makes the case fail.
Fresh adversarial cases execute with zero coverage gaps; if developers inspected these 27 during repair, another sealed independent set is required for unseen closure.
Multi-chunk retrieval always aligns projected content, chunk identity, ranks, and persisted document_id under generative chunk/query cases.
Every started write-tool call has exactly one correlated terminal record for success, denied, error, timeout, cancelled, or outcome-unknown; side-effect claims are backed by typed receipts.
ContextAssembler property tests continue to show zero successful-prompt violations under the declared estimator.
The 28 Reviewer A disputes are adjudicated or remain explicitly non-Gold.
Implementation, tests, manifests, reports, and documentation use the same bounded claims and a fresh-context reviewer revalidates them.
